title: When speech keeps outrunning wisdom after the mind has slipped
issueStatement: Words arrive before the heart has been cleaned enough to carry them well. The problem now is not only temptation or pain, but what to do after the slip has already happened.
centralInsight: Guru makes speech answer to praise, restraint, and truthfulness. Gurbani keeps repair close to remembrance, humility, and return instead of theatre.
practicalReflection: Guard the tongue, and the heart begins to clear. Refuse one unnecessary sharp word before it leaves the mouth.
actionPrompt: Refuse one unnecessary sharp word before it leaves the mouth. Choose the next truthful return instead of rehearsing the failure.
